Completed [DES-039 technology dossier]([redacted]

Recommended common package: 1800 mm long, 1200 mm tungsten/fibre sampling, R50–290 mm installed, rear SiPM readout. It provides 96 L/S tower signals and 1536 sensor pixels per end.

Screening calculations give 11.21 nuclear interaction lengths and 4.725 t tungsten per end. Electronics heat estimates are 109/458 W including conversion.

Primary sources, optical routing, material calculations, cooling assumptions and unresolved radiation/machine interfaces are documented. Only the assigned file changed; no runtime validation or performance claim.
